opening.argument: The presentation promotes Bitcoin as an exceptional wealth opportunity by directing viewers toward acquisition while predicting extraordinary appreciation: “When money begins flowing into Bitcoin, price is going to go up faster than any investment in the world because there's a limited supply of bitcoins.” It also points viewers toward obtaining Bitcoin through Coinbase, stating that “Coinbase is the easiest way to acquire Bitcoins.” Alongside these purchase-oriented claims, the description advertises a separate “Bitcoin 2.0 opportunity” at OneCoinMillionaire.info: “Don't miss Bitcoin 2.0 opportunity! www.OneCoinMillionaire.info” The combination of crisis-based persuasion, exaggerated financial expectations, and solicitation to participate supports the stated position rather than a report or critique of deceptive activity.
